about.title: About SocialModa
about.intro: A leather house built on patience, restraint and the belief that one great jacket outlasts a hundred average ones.
about.body:
SocialModa began with a simple frustration: leather jackets that looked impressive on the rack but gave up after two winters. We set out to make the opposite, a small collection of timeless silhouettes made from carefully selected full-grain hides.

Every jacket is cut, stitched and finished by experienced artisans. We favour natural tanning, solid hardware and linings that feel as good as the leather outside. The result is a jacket that develops character with every year you wear it.

We keep the collection deliberately small. Fewer styles means more attention on each one, from the first sketch to the last stitch.

highlights.title: Full-grain leather
